name: vicinae-fd-search
title: FD File Search
description: Blazing fast file search with rich previews, category filtering, and smart fallbacks
author: mintori

commands.name: index
commands.title: Search Files
commands.subtitle: fd File Search with Preview
commands.description: Search files with instant preview, category filters, and graceful fallbacks

preferences.name: rootPath
preferences.title: Search Root Directory
preferences.description: Root directory to start searching from. Defaults to Home directory (~).

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Max Results
preferences.description: Maximum number of file search results to display.

preferences.name: showHidden
preferences.title: Show Hidden Files
preferences.description: Include hidden files (dotfiles) in search results.
preferences.label: Show hidden files

preferences.name: usePlocate
preferences.title: Use System Index (plocate)
preferences.description: Use system locate database instead of on-the-fly fd scanning for instant disk-wide search.
preferences.label: Enable plocate hybrid index

preferences.name: excludedDirs
preferences.title: Excluded Directories
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of directories to ignore.

preferences.name: shiftOpenApp
preferences.title: Alternative Application (Shift + Enter)
preferences.description: Application to open file with [Shift + Enter] (e.g. Code editor, terminal, or specific app). Leave empty for system Open With dialog.
